notes:
I couldn't write the Psalm 26 notes this time. My first attempt to fetch the source pages failed with a coding error, and then the research tool hit its usage limit for this session. I didn't get to read any of the pages. You asked me to report only what the sources actually say and not to fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I've left out every note rather than guess.

The pages I tried to fetch, which I'll use when I try again:
- https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-26/
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/psalms/26-1.htm (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit and others)
- https://www.preceptaustin.org/psalm-26-commentary
- https://netbible.org/bible/Psalms+26 (translators' notes)
- https://www.newadvent.org/bible/psa026.htm
- https://www.studylight.org/commentaries/eng/geb/psalms-26.html (Gill)

On a second try I'd also look for:
- **Reformed and Baptist:** Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* (spurgeon.org or ccel.org) and Calvin's commentary (ccel.org).
- **Methodist:** Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu).
- **Lutheran:** lcms.org and 1517.org.
- **Catholic and Orthodox:** catholic.com and oca.org. The washing of hands in v. 6 matters here because the Latin Mass used it in the priest's hand-washing prayer (the *Lavabo*).
- **Other topics:** gotquestions.org on David's claims to integrity (vv. 1, 11).

Please send the request again, or just say "try again," and I'll start the research over and write the notes verse by verse with a link for each point.
